title: AI Visibility Index: which agencies do ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini recommend?
description: Open measurement of how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini answer buying questions about agencies for AI search visibility (GEO) in German and English. Baseline of 525 measurements (September 2026) and bi-weekly pulse measurements, with named providers and cited sources. Live index with measurement diary: https://www.grovia-digital.com/en/geo-visibility-index/
